column1: # Models scored in the paper: one row per label. Read by scoring/run_scoring.sh.
#   label          revision label written into scores.csv.gz; also the name of the output directory
#   scorer         olmo     = score_injection_v2.py (OLMo-native checkpoint: model.pt + config.yaml)
#                  olmo_ext = score_injection_v2_extended.py (same, plus mu/sigma over the vocabulary)
#   model          checkpoint or model directory, relative to the data root ($OLMO_TWIN_DATA);
#                  a shell glob is allowed and must match exactly one directory
#   out_dir        output directory, relative to the data root
#   bundle         directory the evaluation manifest's tokens_relpath are relative to, relative to the
#                  data root; "-" = bundle/. The evaluation manifest is <bundle>/evaluation_manifest.csv.gz.
#   expected_seed  value of `seed:` that the checkpoint's config.yaml must declare ("-" = not checked).
#                  The seed-42 checkpoints (AI2's "ingredient3", and our treated run, which declares seed
#                  42 as well) are the control; the seed-42069 checkpoints ("ingredient1") are the
#                  independent reference and must never be scored as the control.
#   extra_flags    further arguments for the scorer, passed to both the scoring and the merge pass
# Sources of the rows: the scoring_meta.rank*.json files written by the scorers in each output directory.
# The post-training run directories are named by open-instruct: <exp_name>__<seed>__<suffix>. SFT and DPO
# runs end in __0; the RLVR runs end in their launch time (a Unix timestamp), hence the globs. The pattern
# [0-9]*[0-9] matches the final model directory but not its sibling <run>_checkpoints/, which holds the
# The cohort-F rows score the 556 re-parsed cohort-F documents (run/cohortF_2x2/, written by
# scoring/cohortF_2x2_tokenise.py); their token paths are relative to run/cohortF_2x2, hence the bundle column.
